title.en: Teach a Hive How to Craft

texts.zh: 我们的科学家十分动摇地离开了[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]。我们希望能够促进对蜂巢的教育计划，这一举措取得了成功，我们计划继续教他们一些基本的化学知识。差不多是立刻，他们就推导出了基于这些原理的最具破坏的应用，我们前脚还没离开他们的大气层，后脚他们就开始对邻近的蜂巢发动战争。现在，数以百万计的子个体正在死亡。
texts.en: Our scientists left [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] today in a shaken state. After the success of our educational initiative with the hive we wish to promote, we proceeded to teach them some basic chemistry. Almost immediately, they extrapolated the most destructive applications of these principles, and started waging war against a neighboring hive before we had even left their atmosphere. Now, millions of drones are dying.

texts.en: Our [Root.GetScientistPlural] were successful with their task on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. After the success of our educational initiative with the hive we wish to promote, we proceeded to teach them some basic chemistry. Almost immediately, they extrapolated the most destructive applications of these principles, and started waging war against a neighboring hive before we had even left their atmosphere. Now, millions of drones are dying.

summary.text:
# 教蜂巢去制造 / Teach a Hive How to Craft

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_dlc_events.txt:8469-8598`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:468, 538-560`（on_five_year_random_pulse_pre_ftl）；`events/on_action_events_2.txt:3146-3179`（action.620/621）

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 每五年的国家检查运行 action.620：拥有“首次接触”DLC、且与某个前超光速文明有生效协议的普通帝国，会在 0–360 天后抽取“前超光速外交事件池”（无事 200，本事件 10，条件不满足的事件被跳过）。
  The five-year country pulse runs action.620: a regular empire with the First Contact DLC and an active agreement with a pre-FTL civilization draws from the pre-FTL diplomacy pool 0-360 days later (nothing 200, this event 10; events whose conditions fail are skipped).
- 条件：我们是格式塔帝国，拥有观测哨站；境内有完全知晓我们、正接受我们公开科技启蒙的格式塔前超光速文明；15 年内不重复。
  Conditions: we are a gestalt with an observation post; a gestalt pre-FTL within our borders is fully aware of us and under our open technological enlightenment; not again for 15 years.
- 发生后设置“近期前超光速外交事件”冷却，其他此类事件暂不出现。
  Afterwards a "recent pre-FTL diplomatic event" cooldown blocks the other events of this pool for a while.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 7510「教蜂巢去制造」：教会他们基础化学后，他们立刻用它来打仗。
  7510 "Teach a Hive How to Craft": after learning basic chemistry they immediately wage war with it.
- “阻止这一切！”：他们暂时不信任我们，星球上 200 人口死亡；（不重视他者）“进步的本质”：他们进入下一科技时代，500 人口死亡。单页事件。
  "Stop this!": they distrust us for a time and 200 pops die; (does not value others) "the nature of progress": they advance to their next age and 500 pops die. A single window.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 这是可重复抽取的随机外交插曲之一（各事件本身每个帝国通常一次），与同池其他事件没有固定顺序。
  One of the random diplomacy interludes of this pool (each usually once per empire), with no fixed order relative to the others.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 正文按我们是否为格式塔分两种（实际触发要求格式塔）。
  Two texts by whether we are a gestalt (the trigger requires gestalt).

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：触发与选项效果提示。
  Checked: trigger and option effect tooltips.
